title: 第17章 训练秒了第5章 嘻嘻我一定要活下去口牙
content_zh:
见王生态度诚恳，刘盈婉表情好看了不少，但还是继续追问：
“那你怎么解释你身上沐浴露和洗发水的味道？”
“这个啊，说来话长，我周末晚上去给一家店看场子......”
接下来这段就是谎言了。
毕竟打黑拳的事情不方便和任何人说，也不光彩。
“然后那个醉汉吐了我一身，人家女顾客为表感谢，除了给我钱之外，还让我去她家洗了澡......当然，我可是什么都没做啊，洗完澡就规规矩矩地走了。”
闻言，刘盈婉眨巴起大眼睛：
“那个女顾客漂亮么？”
“呃......漂亮吧。”
王生回想起虞吟霜的长相，的确惊艳。
当然，刘盈婉也不差，只是年龄还小没彻底长开，脸还有些圆钝，成年后也肯定是个大美人。
“哦，好吧。”
刘盈婉点头过后，便不再说话了。
众人很快来到操场，老秦开始为大家讲解实战中的异能运用：
“比如杨信，他的扩散特性虽然会让放电威力降低，但如果不使用特性，只是单纯的放电呢？”
说着，老秦朝空气中挥了一拳，并在打击落点的末端迸发出一道劲气。
砰！！
空气中迸发了一道爆鸣。
“就像这样把握好电力释放时机，在你击中敌人、力传导的瞬间放电，便可叠加伤害，至少能造成一击麻痹效果，同理，踢击、掌击，乃至关节技，不同的情景都可运用。”
“光说没有意义，杨信你出来，我找个同学和你对练，其他同学则要在这次示范里去想、去思考，能否将其借鉴化为自身技巧。”

杨信很快上场。
“至于你的对手嘛......王生，你来吧。”
“我？”
原本被点到名微微有些惊讶，但很快嘴角带起一抹笑意。
收拾杨信么？那可太好了。
刚刚不是他大嘴巴，王生还不至于被老秦叫来留下。
“咔嚓、咔嚓。”
他掰动起指头关节，又扭了几下脖子，一副跃跃欲试的样子。
这直接给杨信吓慌了：
“别！老秦，你给我换个对手，换个对手行不行？”
杨信可是亲眼见识过王生一拳打出将近一吨威力的拳头，他才不敢打王生！
况且一天半不见，王生的气质好像变得更可怕了！
老秦扶额无语：
“看你这样子，毫无斗志，等考试了该怎么办？习武之人不应怯战，不然还没开打就输一半了。算了，你下去吧，张志超，你来做王生的对手。”
班长张志超，中品凡骨，异能【石化】。
content_en:
Seeing Wang Sheng's sincere attitude, Liu Yingwan's expression became much better, but she still continued to ask:
"Then how do you explain the smell of shower gel and shampoo on you?"
"Well, it's a long story. I went to check out a store on weekend nights..."
What follows is a lie.
After all, it's not convenient to tell anyone about black boxing, and it's not honorable either.
"Then the drunk man vomited all over me. As a thank you, the female customer not only gave me money, but also let me go to her house to take a shower... Of course, I didn't do anything. After taking a shower, I left in a polite manner."
Hearing this, Liu Yingwan blinked her big eyes:
"Is that female customer pretty?"
"Uh...beautiful."
Wang Sheng recalled that Yu Yinshuang's appearance was indeed stunning.
Of course, Liu Yingwan is not bad, but she is still young and has not fully grown, and her face is still a bit round. She will definitely be a beauty when she becomes an adult.
"Oh, okay."
After Liu Yingwan nodded, she stopped talking.
Everyone quickly arrived at the playground, and Lao Qin began to explain to everyone the use of superpowers in actual combat:
"For example, Yang Xin, although his diffusion characteristics will reduce the power of discharge, what if he does not use the characteristics and just discharges?"
As he spoke, Lao Qin punched the air, and a blast of energy burst out at the end of the impact point.
Bang! !
An explosion erupted in the air.
"Just like this, grasp the timing of releasing electricity, and discharge it at the moment when you hit the enemy and the force is transmitted, and the damage can be superimposed, which can cause at least one paralysis effect. In the same way, kicks, palm strikes, and even joint techniques can be used in different situations."
"It's meaningless to just talk. Come out, Yang Xin, and I'll find a classmate to spar with you. The other students will have to think about this demonstration and see if they can learn from it and turn it into their own skills."
Yang Xin came on the scene soon.
"As for your opponent...Wang Sheng, come on."
"Me?"
Initially, he was slightly surprised to be called, but soon a smile appeared on his lips.
Are you going to take care of Yang Xin? That would be great.
If it hadn't been for his big mouth just now, Wang Sheng wouldn't have been asked by Lao Qin to stay.
"Click, click."
He cracked his knuckles and twisted his neck a few times, looking eager to try.
This immediately frightened Yang Xin:
"No! Old Qin, can you change my opponent? Can you change my opponent?"
Yang Xin had personally seen Wang Sheng punch with nearly a ton of power, so he didn't dare to hit Wang Sheng!
Besides, after not seeing each other for a day and a half, Wang Sheng’s temperament seems to have become even more terrifying!
Old Qin held his forehead and was speechless:
"Looking at you like this, you have no fighting spirit. What should you do when the exam comes? People who practice martial arts should not be timid in fighting, otherwise they will lose half of the fight before the fight begins. Forget it, go down, Zhang Zhichao, you will be Wang Sheng's opponent."
Squad leader Zhang Zhichao has middle-grade mortal bones and the ability [Petrification].
